The '''Mk 1/S concussion missile launcher''' was a type of [[Concussion missile launcher/Legends|concussion missile launcher]]. They were mounted on [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] combat-modified [[Arrow-23 landspeeder/Legends|Arrow-23 landspeeders]].
